unit: Students can welcome a guest, introduce someone, make basic small talk, and politely offer a drink.
objective: Welcome a guest, introduce someone, make small talk, and offer a drink.

title: Warm-up
subtitle: Hosting a guest
question: What do you usually do when a guest visits your home?

title: Useful Language (Part 1)
teacher_instructions: Read each word aloud and ask the student to repeat it.
Read the definition and the example sentence.
Ask the check question to confirm understanding.
Ask the student to make their own sentence using one of the words.

words.definition: To greet someone in a friendly way when they arrive.
words.check: Do you say 'welcome' when a guest arrives or when they leave?

words.definition: A hot, dark drink that many people have in the morning.
words.check: Do people usually drink coffee to wake up or to go to sleep?

title: Useful Language (Part 2)
teacher_instructions: Read each word aloud and ask the student to repeat.
Read the definition and example sentence.
Ask the check question to confirm understanding.
Ask the student to make their own sentence using one of the words.

words.definition: to see and speak to someone for the first time
words.check: Would you say 'Nice to meet you' to your brother or to a new friend?

words.definition: a person who visits your home or office
words.example: I have a guest at my house today.
words.check: Is a guest someone who lives in your house or someone who visits?

words.definition: to rest on a chair or seat
words.check: Do you usually sit on a chair or stand on a chair?

title: Conversation Builder
goal: Learn how to offer a seat and a drink to a guest.

linkers.use: Invite the guest to take a seat.
Say this when handing a drink to your guest.
A polite expression to use when serving a drink.

model:
A: Welcome! Please sit down.
B: Thank you.
A: So, would you like some coffee or juice?
B: I'd love some coffee, please.
A: Alright, here is your drink. Enjoy.
B: Thanks a lot.

your_turn.teacher: You are the guest, and the student is the host. Have the student welcome you, offer you a seat, and serve you a drink using the new phrases.
your_turn.student: Welcome your teacher and invite them to sit down. Offer them a drink and say, 'Here is your drink. Enjoy.'

title: Let's practice
teacher_question: Imagine I'm a guest visiting your home. Welcome me, ask me to sit down, and offer me a drink. You have coffee, juice, and water. Use the sentences below to help you.
student_guide: Would you like some _____ or juice?

title: Real-world scenario
problem: The tutor is visiting your home or office. You want to be a good host and make them feel welcome.
mission: Welcome the guest and ask them to take a seat.
Introduce a colleague or family member.
Make small talk and offer them a drink, like coffee or juice.
start: Hi there! Welcome to my home. Please, come on in.

title: Wrap-up
recap: Vocabulary: welcome, coffee, meet, guest, sit
Phrases: Please sit down. / Here is your drink. / Enjoy.
Skills: You can welcome a guest, introduce someone, and offer a drink.
final_task: Quick question: What phrase do you use when handing a cup of coffee to a guest?
challenge: Next time you have a visitor, try saying 'Welcome' and 'Please sit down' in English.
